review_method: Human inspection of actual Win32 screenshots at 1024x768 and 1536x960; RESOLVED denotes visually reviewed repair, not automatic verification or industrial qualification.

known_defects.title: Overview KPI and annunciator text crowding
known_defects.observation: Native overview KPI cards and eight-across alarm annunciator row visibly overdraw or truncate long labels, values and neighboring tiles at 1024px; text lacks adequate horizontal allocation.
known_defects.acceptance: Reflow or clip/shorten per-tile labels with nonoverlap; verify all KPI figures and alarm annunciators in screenshot at 1024x768.
known_defects.resolution: Implemented width-aware 1024px overview including compact interactive KPI/flow/subsystem layout, short annunciator codes and bounded main viewport.

review_evidence.comparison: Native Windows screenshots reviewed before and after

known_defects.title: Header status and instrumentation labels overlap
known_defects.observation: Virtual native 1536px Exergy screen shows long upper status banner overdrawn by adjacent status/module labels, plus text drawn through plot/panel annotations.
known_defects.acceptance: Separate header status row from secondary labels and ensure chart annotations occupy nonintersecting bounding boxes at 1536x960.
known_defects.resolution: Separated status/chip regions and corrected Exergy Sobol, Grassmann, waterfall and bottom interpretation geometry at 1536px.

review_evidence.comparison: Native Windows screenshots reviewed before and after

known_defects.title: Control sidebar help and slider headings collide
known_defects.observation: Control-sidebar help/cue text crosses first visible slider heading when the sidebar is scrolled, so an operator cannot read all labels without collisions.
known_defects.acceptance: Reserve fixed vertical space for cue/help message; confirm slider headings stay readable throughout scroll range.
known_defects.resolution: Separated scrolling slider body from fixed help band, clipped scrollable content below header, and fit concise slider/footer labels.

review_evidence.comparison: Native Windows screenshots reviewed before and after

known_defects.title: Dense 1024px analytics pages exceed right panel viewport
known_defects.observation: The new every-screen native 1024px acceptance capture reveals layout clipping/overflow in the Day-Ahead MINLP view and other dense analytical screens (notably diagnostics, fleet and carbon), despite correct screen navigation and screenshot generation.
known_defects.acceptance: Provide viewport-specific layouts or genuine navigable scrolling for dense analytical panels, and verify text, plots and control hotspots on all 16 native 1024x768 captures. Do not count a screenshot's existence as readability proof.
